# Famous Sites Atlas Source

Mirrored from `https://learnui.qiaomu.ai/sites/` for this local project.

The reproduced `DESIGN.md` documents originate from VoltAgent's
`awesome-design-md` project under the MIT license. The live LearnUI page adds
curation, bilingual reading notes, brand mockups, and navigation.

Run `python3 scripts/sync-sites.py` to refresh the local mirror.
